steps.content: Run!
This is the only thought burning in Sibilla's mind. She tears forward, the sting of her wounds lost beneath the rush of adrenaline.
(Scene Change: Back alley of the hall)

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>This is the place. I remember this back alley leads to...</color>
(Scene Change: Syndicate)
Syndicate.

This is the place Sibilla has known only through sketchbooks and the tales of traveling merchants. Vast as a labyrinth, it makes the perfect den of iniquity, where those who wish to vanish slip into the shadows without a trace.
She has no guarantee that she can shake off her pursuer here, but waiting for death is not an option.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Haha, this layout... looks a lot like Furor... I'm good at this.

Dilapidated buildings loom, their alleyways narrow as capillaries. Garbage and filth choke the space between ground and sky, and through it all, people wander—living in the chaos of it. Everything feels familiar to her.
Sibilla glances back, only to see a group of Syndicate thugs have cornered her pursuer in the middle of the street.

steps.speaker: Syndicate Thug
steps.content: Hey, who the **** are you?? Walking around my block like you own it? Where did you even pop out from?

steps.speaker: Syndicate Thug
steps.content: Those clothes... You're not a Syndican. You're a ******* spy from Nirvana, eh?
The armed thugs close in, blocking the assassin from every angle. Their leader snarls a curse, knife glinting in the light. But the answer they get is just one.
Clang—!
With a sharp metallic clang, the thug suddenly finds his hands empty.
Before a scream can escape him, his vision warps, as if his head has torn free from his body, thrown into the sky...
...and lands with a thud on the sewage-streaked ground.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Eeeeek!!!!

When the assassin finally leaves, Sibilla crawls from the blood-splattered garbage heap on all fours, her hiding place now a tomb. But she doesn't even have the luxury of doing something for the decapitated corpse.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: That person's an assassin, someone completely mad! There's no way they'll back down!

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I can't lead them to where there are people... That would only get innocent people killed!!
She has no choice but to run. Fortunately, running is something she excels at.
She claws her way up crumbling walls and deliberately presses bloody handprints at crossings to lead the assassin astray.
The evasive maneuvers successfully buy her distance from the assassin—but at a cost. Now, she finds herself lost in the vast labyrinth of the slum.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: *Pant*...
The sun is gradually setting.

Her fingers have gone numb, her legs distant and foreign beneath her. Pain pulses from her wounds in relentless waves—if this lasts much longer, the assassin won't even need to strike the final blow. Infection or hypothermia will do the work for them.
A ghostly voice suddenly whispers behind her, followed by a searing pain splitting her chest. Sibilla lowers her gaze, only to see a silver blade protrude from her body.
Her vision gradually floods with crimson.
(Black Screen)

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Hang in there... Hang in there... Not yet...
Option C - Right Side [Live]

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I have to go back... need to give this to someone... I already saw him...
steps.female_content: I have to go back... need to give this to someone... I already saw her...

steps.content: Her strength bleeds away with every step. Fingers clenched around the protective charm—her townspeople's final gift—she staggers around the corner and breaks into a desperate sprint.
But her hope is quickly shattered, plunging her into despair once more.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: No...
(Scene Change: Show wall)
Before her stands a solid brick wall. The afterglow of sunset paints the weathered stones with an ominous blood-red hue.
Behind her, she hears the footsteps of death.
